items.title: 2D Platform Game
items.desc: 2D platformer game where the alien character must return to space. Made using Unity3D. It was developed by me and another Unity developer. It was made in a few days. Player can control objects in front of the character with the mouse before the character reach it.

items.title: AI Made Game: 2D Submarine Simulation
items.desc: Have you ever seen a game that is almost 100% made by AI 🤖To test the true power of LLMs, I decided to build and publish a complete web based 2D game from scratch in less than a month.

items.title: Herds: RTS PC Game
items.desc: Our zombie find himself in a town filled with fresh humans and he just want one bite.This game uses a new idea, if you like the idea of growing your own army of zombies please like and share the game, it would also help us if you tell us any opinion or suggestion you may have. This is a Real Time Strategy (RTS) game. It was made using Unity 3D and its URP (Universal Render Pipeline). The idea of the game is to control a group of zombies and infect humans to make them join your army.

items.title: "The" Savior: a Game jam game
items.desc: A hero with two consciences fighting inside her, Who wins? Who lose? You decide?Requires 2 controllers, Triggers and thumb sticks to control the character.

items.title: Blindwaves: A Game Jam Game
items.desc: A 2017 Global Game Jam game that uses Keijiro Takahashi waves shader where the player is a blind man who can only sees the sound waves and there is a zombie that he must evade and save the princess.

items.title: Unity DOTS/ECS City
items.desc: An experimental Real-Time Strategy (RTS) prototype developed in 2020 to explore Unity's Data-Oriented Technology Stack (DOTS) and Entity Component System (ECS). The core gameplay revolved around a dynamic day-and-night cycle where players strategically organized and managed their own protests. Although it showcased promising mechanics, the project was ultimately archived; the early DOTS framework was highly unstable at the time, with frequent crashes and rapidly shifting APIs that made sustained development impractical.

items.title: Soul Game
items.desc: A 2019 Global Game Jam game made to resemble a Dark Souls game. Made in 2 days only. For the water I made my own shader in Unity.

items.title: Space Fight: 2D WebGL Browser Game
items.desc: A 2D space fighting game. It runs on the browser using WebGL.
